context.situation: Your company is deciding whether to keep hybrid working. Two colleagues are discussing it in the kitchen, and they ask what you think.
context.situation_ar: شركتك تقرر ما إذا كانت ستُبقي على العمل الهجين. زميلان يناقشان الموضوع في المطبخ ويسألانك عن رأيك.
context.goal: Give and justify an opinion, agree and disagree politely, and acknowledge the other side.
context.goal_ar: أن تعطي رأيًا وتبرره، وتوافق وتخالف بأدب، وتعترف بوجهة النظر الأخرى.

input.title: Should we go back to the office?

script.t: Have you heard? Management wants everyone back in the office four days a week.
Honestly, I think that's a mistake. I get far more done at home. No commute, no interruptions.
I see your point, but I'm not sure I agree. Half the team started during the pandemic, and some of them have never really met anyone.
That's true, I suppose. But surely that depends on how the team is managed, not where people sit.
To some extent. On the other hand, you learn so much just by overhearing people solve problems.
OK, you have a point there. Although I'd argue that two days would be enough for that.
Maybe. To be honest, I think it wasn't an easy decision to make. They're trying to keep everyone happy.
Well, they won't. What about you? Where do you stand?

gist.prompt: Which sentence best summarises the discussion?
options: They disagree, but each accepts part of the other's argument.
They completely agree that the office is better.
Raj persuades Chloe to work from home.

detail.prompt: What is Chloe's main argument for the office?
options: New team members learn from being around others.
People work harder when a manager can see them.
The office is cheaper for the company.

inference.prompt: What does Raj's final "Well, they won't" suggest?
options: He thinks some people will be unhappy whatever management decides.
He is going to leave the company.

inference.prompt: How does Chloe feel about management?
options: She's fairly sympathetic — she thinks the decision was hard.

notice.quote: I see your point, but I'm not sure I agree.

question.prompt: What is Chloe doing with this sentence?
options: Showing respect for Raj's idea before disagreeing

notice.explain: Acknowledge → then disagree. It keeps a discussion friendly. Note: "I agree", "I'm not sure I agree" — never "I am agree".
notice.explain_ar: اعترف بالفكرة ثم خالف. ولاحظ: I agree وليس I am agree.

notice.quote: Although I'd argue that two days would be enough.

options: A contrast — a limit to what he just accepted

notice.explain: although / however / on the other hand all introduce a contrast, but they sit in different places in the sentence.
notice.explain_ar: هذه الروابط كلها للتضاد، لكن مواقعها في الجملة مختلفة.

grammar.title: Contrast: although, however, on the other hand, while
grammar.context: Although I'd argue that two days would be enough… On the other hand, you learn so much by overhearing people.
grammar.pattern: Although + clause, clause · Clause. However, clause. · Clause. On the other hand, clause. · While + clause, clause
examples: Although it saves time, working from home can be lonely.
Commuting is tiring. However, it separates work from home.
Offices are expensive. On the other hand, they help teams bond.
While I see the benefits, I still prefer the office.
grammar.explain: Although/while join two ideas in ONE sentence. However/on the other hand start a NEW sentence and need a comma.
grammar.explain_ar: although/while تربطان فكرتين في جملة واحدة، و however/on the other hand تبدأان جملة جديدة.

practice.sentence: I am agree with you about the commute.
answers: I agree with you about the commute.
practice.why: Agree is a verb, so we don't use am before it.
practice.why_ar: agree فعل، لا نضع قبله am.

errors.why: However can't join two clauses in one sentence. Use although / while.
